findings.title: Pydantic UserWarning on every invocation (stderr noise)
findings.detail: Every autodev invocation emits two pydantic UserWarnings to stderr: 'Field model_hint in AgentCard has conflict with protected namespace model_' and 'Field model_settings in AgentSpec has conflict with protected namespace model_'. These warnings originate from pydantic model definitions in the installed package. Not a crash, not an import error, but pollutes stderr on every command. Fix: add model_config = ConfigDict(protected_namespaces=()) to AgentCard and AgentSpec.
findings.evidence: stderr on every `autodev <cmd> --help`: /opt/homebrew/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_fields.py:132: UserWarning: Field 'model_hint' in AgentCard has conflict with protected namespace 'model_'.

summary_one_line: 35/35 commands pass: exit 0 + Usage/Options in stdout + no Traceback; zero P0/P1; 1 P2 (pydantic model_ namespace warnings on every invocation).
